rationale: Maximize inverter active output (p_inv=20, the availability limit; 20^2+8^2=464<=576 capability) so diesel active is minimized at p_diesel=34-20=14 MW. Set q_diesel=4 MVAr (preferred) and q_inverter=8 MVAr to zero the deviation penalty. Voltage = 0.965+0.0025*(4+8)=0.995 pu, within [0.95,1.05]. Cost = 14*76 + 0*3 = 1064.
